title: Encoded PowerShell command line
desc: PowerShell launched with an encoded command. Common in loaders; tune for admin tooling.
rule:
title: Encoded PowerShell Command Line
status: experimental
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -encodedcommand '
  condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001

title: Certutil used to download a file
desc: certutil with -urlcache and a URL is a well-known living-off-the-land download method.
rule:
title: Certutil Download
status: experimental
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '-urlcache'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105

title: Password spray from one source
desc: One source IP failing logons against many accounts in a 10 minute window. Adjust index and threshold.
rule:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4625
| bin _time span=10m
| stats dc(TargetUserName) as users count by _time, IpAddress
| where users > 10
| sort - users
